results.title: AEW Collision from Vegas Review: Upsets and Drama
results.description: El Presidente reviews AEW Collision from Vegas featuring Continental Challenge Cup action with upsets and drama. The show features several exciting matches, including Kyle O'Reilly vs. Roderick Strong and Hechicero vs. Brian Cage. Mercedes Moné's post-match attack on Zayda Steel and Christopher Daniels adds to the drama.
